entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is AutoVoice, how can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought recently. This thing is junk.
Hello, I apologize for the wait time. My name is Sarah. I can definitely help you with that return. To confirm, you want to return a VeloBand Pulse?
Yes, that's exactly what I said! The VeloBand Pulse. I bought it like, two weeks ago. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. It's practically useless!
Okay, I understand your frustration. Can you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's [customer email address]. Just hurry this up. I'm already late for something.

Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse from 15 days ago. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the purchase date. So you're well within that window.
90 days? Great! I was worried I was stuck with this garbage. What do I need to do?

I can process a return for you right away. You can return the VeloBand Pulse for a full refund. We'll send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address within the next hour. Just repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, if possible, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Sounds good. Will I get the refund on my credit card?

Yes, the refund will be credited back to the original payment method. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear on your statement. We strive for faster turnarounds, but it could take up to 10 days. In general, any VeloFit device, including a smart watch, is covered by our robust return policy.
Okay, that's fair. I appreciate you taking care of this so quickly. What about the original shipping cost?
Since the VeloBand Pulse is faulty, we'll also refund the original shipping cost. You won't be out any money due to this inconvenience. We want you to be happy with your VeloFit products.
Wow, okay. That's actually really good customer service. Better than I expected. So, I just wait for the email with the label?

That is correct. You will receive an email within the hour with the prepaid shipping label and instructions. If you don't receive it, please don't hesitate to call us back. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks for your help. You've been great.
You're very welcome! Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day!
